prompt: The aircraft banks gently and the horizon tilts a few degrees as the city slides under the wing, with slight cabin vibration. Beyond the depot a second fat white-orange dome of fire goes up and lights the underside of the smoke, silent at this height. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so anything moving fast smears with natural motion blur. One continuous shot, no cuts.
why: Kai 9 Nov mood board r2: 'let's just cut videos of all of these' (scale round)
